intro_zh: 先听完整课文，再按中文侦探线记忆：火终于扑灭、从那以后一直查原因、常见原因是碎玻璃和烟头、地面调查排除了它们、一个消防员偶然发现高压线上的蛇线索，最后还原出鸟、蛇、电线、火花、起火的因果链。读的时候注意 have put out 和 have been trying 的节奏，长句要分组，wound 在本课读作 wind 的过去式。

sentences.text: At last firemen have put out a big forest fire in California.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：消防员终于扑灭了一场加利福尼亚森林大火。At last 读出终于完成的感觉，have put out 强调结果：火已经灭了。

sentences.text: Since then, they have been trying to find out how the fire began.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：从那以后，他们一直在查火是怎么烧起来的。Since then 后稍停，have been trying 读出持续调查，find out 要连成一个意义块。

sentences.text: Forest fires are often caused by broken glass or by cigarette ends which people carelessly throw away.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：森林火灾常常由碎玻璃或人们随手扔掉的烟头引起。are often caused by 是被动原因结构，broken glass 和 cigarette ends 分组读。

sentences.text: Yesterday the firemen examined the ground carefully, but were not able to find any broken glass.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：昨天消防员仔细检查地面，但没有找到碎玻璃。examined 和 carefully 要读清楚，but 后面读出调查后的排除结果。

sentences.text: This morning, however, a firemen accidentally discovered the cause.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：然而今天上午，一个消防员偶然发现了原因。这里照课文原文读 a firemen；讲解里已说明标准单数是 a fireman 或 a firefighter。however 前后有转折，accidentally discovered the cause 是关键块。

sentences.text: He noticed the remains of a snake which was wound round the electric wires of a 16,000-volt power line.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：他发现一条蛇的遗骸缠在十六千伏高压线的电线上。remains 温和理解成留下的东西，wound 在本课读作 wind 的过去式，长句按 clue 分组慢读。

sentences.text: A bird had snatched up the snake from the ground and then dropped it on to the wires.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：一只鸟从地上抓起蛇，然后把它掉到电线上。had snatched up 是过去完成时，说明这个动作发生在发现线索之前；dropped it on to the wires 不要读散。

sentences.text: When it did so, it sent sparks down to the ground and these immediately started a fire.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：当蛇这样做时，火花落到地面，立刻引起火灾。When it did so 后稍停，sent sparks down 和 immediately started a fire 是最终因果链。
